name: @hs666-ai/dsh-tencent-docs-bridge
description: Community (unofficial) bridge to Tencent Docs official MCP: one-click mcp-client configuration + self-served space_secret acquisition (scan → local vault → gateway). Zero bundled credentials. · 社区（非官方）腾讯文档 MCP 桥：一键配置官方 mcp-client 连接 docs.qq.com MCP 端点 + 自足取票（扫码→本地 vault→网关），不内置任何凭据。

scripts.build: node scripts/check-no-token.mjs && node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/resolver.js && node --check lib/vault.js && node --check lib/mcp.js && node --check lib/login.js && node --check bin/tdoc-auth.mjs
scripts.test: node tests/vault.test.mjs && node tests/mcp.test.mjs && node tests/resolver.test.mjs && node tests/applier.test.mjs && node tests/login.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run test
